senses.gloss: X-rays are a type of invisible light beyond ultra-violet. They pass through skin and tissue, but not bone, making it useful in medicine. X-rays are a type of radiation.
A photograph taken with X-rays
examples: When John broke his arm, he had an X-ray taken.

senses.gloss: To X-ray is to take a photograph of an X-ray
examples: The doctor X-rayed the patient's leg

senses.gloss: Something that is X-ray is something to do with X-rays.
examples: The airport had an X-ray scanner.
